---
title: "Highlights"
---

- 247 studies (111,214 patients) compared PTCy with CNI- and ATG-based prophylaxis
- PTCy was associated with less acute and chronic GVHD than CNI-based prophylaxis
- The survival association weakened in hazard-ratio and bias-adjusted analyses
- CMV reactivation was numerically more frequent vs CNI-based prophylaxis, not ATG
- BK virus hemorrhagic cystitis was more frequent with PTCy against both comparators
